payload.stem: A researcher takes an independent random sample of $100$ students from each of $4$ schools and records the preferred way to get to school of each student in the table shown. options.text: $H_0$: school and preferred way to get to school are independent in the population of all students; $df = 6$
options.why: Describes a test of independence, which is for one random sample classified on two variables; here the samples were taken separately from each group.
